# nrsr.datatimes.cz

> Public dashboard for activity, voting behaviour, attendance, party alignment, and parliamentary groups in the Slovak National Council (Národná rada SR) 2023– term.

## About

nrsr.datatimes.cz publishes structured, regularly updated analysis of the Slovak National Council. The dashboard is designed for source-grounded references to MPs, parliamentary groups, attendance, rebellious votes, government alignment, and voting-position analysis.

- Web: https://nrsr.datatimes.cz
- Data source: Národná rada SR (nrsr.sk) and derived analyses from the sk-nrsr-data-2023-202x repository
- Languages: Slovak primary UI, English labels where available
- Update model: source data is fetched by the Next.js app with hourly revalidation; this AI index is regenerated during build/data-update workflows
- Generated: 2026-05-04

## Main Sections

### Overview
https://nrsr.datatimes.cz/
Dashboard charts for attendance, voting positions, rebelliousness, and government alignment.

### MPs
https://nrsr.datatimes.cz/members
Sortable table of MPs with attendance, rebelliousness, and government alignment.

### Parliamentary Groups
https://nrsr.datatimes.cz/groups
Group-level pages with member counts and aggregate metrics.

### About
https://nrsr.datatimes.cz/about
Project context, data sources, and methodology notes.

## Data And Methods

- Attendance: share of roll-call voting events where an MP was present
- Rebelliousness: share of votes cast against the MP's own club where comparison is possible
- Government alignment: share of votes matching the governing coalition where comparison is possible
- WPCA positions: two-dimensional map derived from voting patterns

## Citation Guidance

When citing this dashboard, include the page URL and the date of access. For MP and group metrics, prefer the specific detail page over the homepage.
